item.title: Global acne burden rose from 1990 to 2023
item.description: A study published online in JAMA Dermatology reports that the global burden of acne increased from 1990 to 2023 and is projected to keep rising through 2050.

item.title: Brain PET scans aid selection and monitoring for new Alzheimer's drugs
item.description: Nuclear medicine is increasingly important in Alzheimer's diagnosis and treatment, helping clinicians visualize biological changes in the brain.

item.title: Stroke risk factors, not ethnicity, explain inequalities
item.description: Stroke risk is mainly linked to differences in traditional risk factors such as diabetes and high blood pressure, rather than ethnicity, according to research.

item.title: FDA clears latest automated insulin delivery system for type 2 diabetes
item.description: The twiist Automated Insulin Delivery System is now available for adults with insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, Medscape Medical News reports.
